puzzle.hint: Falsehood — the opposite of established truth in Islamic theology; what divine will renders void.
puzzle.arabicVerse: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
puzzle.verse: 8:8 - That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
